text.tspan: Q26 · /ABC works, /DEF doesn't: follow the path
/ABC works → DNS, TLS and reaching the load balancer are fine. Only one path fails → look at ROUTING.
compare status and headers (server, x-cache): WHICH layer answered?
404 from nginx = routing · 404 from the app = app
502 / 503 / 504 = the LB says the backend is the problem
Also: ALB access logs, DEF target group health, ingress controller logs, app logs, recent deploys.
